# Cards and training

English · [简体中文](Cards-zh-CN.md)

[Home](Home.md) · [Cards](Cards.md) · [Builds](Builds.md) · [Enemies](Enemies.md) · [Stages](Stages.md) · [Mechanics](Mechanics.md) · [Development](Development.md) · [Changelog](Changelog.md) · [Gallery](Gallery.md) · [Brand](Brand.md) · [Validation](Validation.md)

![Earlier Chinese card offer; the game now supports either language](../assets/screenshots/rewards-desktop-v1.png)

51 augments across 12 families: 39 common/rare and 12 epics. Epics are once per run. Every acquisition grants one family stack, even an epic with several effects. Caps are per card ID; composite epic effects do not consume ordinary card stacks. Previews use starting four-lane stats, before wounds; the game shows changes for the current build. Unlimited cards still obey combat caps. High-star endless minions divide received enemy-HP-derived damage, slow strength and stun duration by stars. From depth 4, lifesteal also uses an own-maximum-HP/effective-lifesteal time allowance before healing bonuses, wounds and overheal. From depth 7, minion percentage damage has a further shared depth-scaled allowance; combat healing and generated shields also share an own-HP allowance and future combat shields have a depth-scaled ceiling. Listed coefficients do not guarantee final damage against every target or a healing rate; see [Mechanics](Mechanics.md).

### Overload Sigil

- **Effect:** Increase spell output; briefly suspend common sense. Base damage increases as shown below.
- **Starting preview:** Damage 12 → 16

### Ember Fuse

- **Effect:** Kills explode for 16 damage plus 3% of the source monster's maximum HP per stack. Chains unlock at blast tier 6. Enemy-HP damage shares the target boss or elite's per-second budget; it scales down with a minion's stars. From Endless depth 7, minions also share a per-target percentage-damage allowance that declines with depth.
- **Starting preview:** Kill explosion 0 → 16 · Source maximum HP +3% / stacks

### Starfall Pact

- **Effect:** With enemies present, sacrifice 3 HP every 5s, nonlethally. Explode at a target using base damage, player maximum HP and 2% target maximum HP per stack. Enemy-HP damage shares the target boss or elite's per-second budget; it scales down with a minion's stars. From Endless depth 7, minions also share a per-target percentage-damage allowance that declines with depth.
- **Starting preview:** Sacrifice base damage 0 → 20 · Player HP bonus + Target maximum HP 2% / stacks

### Supernova Heart

- **Effect:** +8 base damage, +2 explosion stacks and +1 sacrifice stack. Once per run.
- **Starting preview:** Base damage +8 · Explosion +2 stacks · Sacrifice +1 stacks

## Boss and Training XP

Automatic training uses separate finite-budget kill credit: T(n)=5000n+1500n(n−1)/2, with cumulative milestones 5,000/11,500/19,500/29,000/40,000. Marginal costs rise arithmetically. Clearance HP bonuses and excess reinforcements add display score only. Multiple crossed milestones settle in order, without pausing or spending score; manual training does not raise automatic thresholds. Stage one excludes lifesteal. Full-stage offers contain two different trainings and one augment: choose one; elites do not grant an extra stage reward. Trainings add no family stacks, persist for the run, and do not appear in chests or supplies. Maximum-HP training does not heal.

| Training / in-game name / ID | Starting change | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Base damage / 基础伤害 / `training-damage` | Base damage 12 → 18 | Adjust run base stats; no family stack |
| Maximum HP / 生命上限 / `training-health` | Maximum HP 100 → 130 | Adjust run base stats; no family stack |
| Attack power / 攻击加成 / `training-power` | Attack power 0% → 10% | Adjust run base stats; no family stack |
| Critical chance / 暴击率 / `training-critical` | Critical chance 0% → 4% | Adjust run base stats; no family stack |
| Critical multiplier / 暴击倍率 / `training-critical-power` | Critical multiplier 1.5 → 1.7 | Adjust run base stats; no family stack |
| Basic lifesteal / 普攻吸血 / `training-leech` | Basic lifesteal 0% → 1.7% | Adjust run base stats; no family stack |
| HP/s / 每秒回复 / `training-renewal` | HP/s 0 → 0.75 | Adjust run base stats; no family stack |
| Firing interval / 攻击间隔 / `training-haste` | Base firing interval 0.380s → 0.357s · Effective interval respects this run's floor | Base interval ×0.94; effective interval respects the active profile floor (official 0.12s); no family stack |
